Job Title: Services Engagement Manager - Development Cloud

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Services Engagement Manager is an experienced, results-driven professional to drive the strategy, positioning, and delivery model for Veeva’s Professional Services. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and external executive leadership—helping life sciences organizations understand the value of partnering with Veeva to achieve their business objectives. You will own the end-to-end engagement design, collaborate across functions, and drive a high-volume pipeline with precision, velocity, and diplomacy.
With a passion for Software Implementation and (preferred) expertise in Life Sciences/Healthcare/IT sales cycles, you’ll draft and deliver RFx Responses, Proposals, and Statements of Work, driving alignment with internal cross-functional subject matter experts and customer leadership.
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. This is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet potential travel requirements when they arise.

What You'll Do

    • Selling Value of Veeva Services: Educate customers on methodology and the value of Veeva’s Professional Services - why should they want to work with us? Set appropriate expectations of what we can/should/won’t do
    • Engagement Design: Define and prescribe the best Professional Services model for a given customer, based on an in-depth understanding of their needs and business objectives, through Proposals, Statements of Work, and RFx responses
    • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, strategy, services, business consulting, solutions consulting, and others to ensure optimal engagement approach and positioning
    • Operational Excellence: Take strong ownership of a high-volume pipeline through consistent execution, a sense of urgency/speed, flawless data management, and appropriate stakeholder communication (from internal Associates to external C-Suite)
    • Leadership Through Influence: Provide thought partnership to the broader business and drive meaningful results without a direct reporting structure; embrace creative conflict with diplomacy and humility

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience delivering software implementation and enhancement projects (Program Manager, Project Manager, Functional/Business Analyst, Practice Manager, etc.)
    • 1+ years of experience scoping/defining project plans, resource models, and negotiation of Statements of Work for software implementation projects a plus
    • Background in Life Sciences, Health Care, or Tech preferred; Experience working with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software applications a plus
    • A problem-solving and customer services-oriented mentality to drive the positioning and sales of professional services; Consulting, Tech Sales, and Program/Project Management experience
    • Remote role based in North America, with ability to work across time zones and travel when required (~10-15%)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $85,000 - $170,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

About Bolt Data

A connected workplace focused on innovation Bolt Data is a connected group of technology enthusiasts that believe collaboration and genuine care for each other are at the core of everything we do. As a long-standing partner of some of the world’s most successful platforms, we offer endless opportunities to expand your technology expertise. We're deeply committed to our team members' career advancement and helping them achieve their professional goals.

Description

A Technical Architect is responsible for partnering with our clients and delivery teams to define, develop, and implement technology solutions that are both innovative and cost-effective, ensuring the highest levels of business efficiency through Architecture best practices including encapsulation and reuses. The Technical Architect generally operates as part of a project team; focusing on the technical design and build of the overall solution and ensuring seamless integration of any custom elements. The Technical Architect maintains a relevant and deep technology skill set, obtaining certifications as necessary and adhering to industry technology standards. A Technology Architect is responsible for the successful implementation of effective technology solutions, ensuring solution quality, business acceptance, and effective transition to support. A Technical Architect is responsible for maturing the Bolt Data technology practice; enabling Bolt Data to deliver work smarter.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Establish effective working relationships with key client and project team stakeholders
  • Communicate and manage expectations regarding delivery updates, risks, issues, and opportunities with key stakeholders
  • Lead Requirements Gathering and Solution Design activities; influencing decisions regarding effectiveness, dependability, flexibility, scalability, supportability, and total cost of platforms and supporting technologies
  • Partner with Solution Architect to develop technical specifications for custom development and system integration requirements, including estimations for delivery time, cost, and resources
  • Develop detailed technical design documents that align to solution design specifications
  • Liaise between clients, project leads, and other delivery teams (including vendors) to communicate status, drive delivery performance, manage risks, and remove barriers
  • Lead technology design, configuration, and development activities, including database and environment migrations, across multiple projects; ensuring adherence to development standards, alignment to technical specifications, and delivery to agreed timelines
  • Document final solution and lead knowledge transition to client support team
  • Work with project team to develop and validate estimates to support any Change Orders
  • Contribute to estimating and SOW templates for future phases
  • Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
  • Coach and mentor junior technical and functional team members

Professional Capabilities:

  • 8+ years of hands-on technical experience with ServiceNow implementations with a minimum of 5 enterprise level technology projects
  • 8+ years of experience in software implementations with one or more Customer Relationship Management Solution (such as Oracle, SalesForce.com, SAP, Siebel, or other CRM software). Configuration experience is a must
  • 4+ years working within the ServiceNow ecosystem as a Technical Architect
  • Expert level understanding of the ServiceNow product suite, including CRM, Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, Sales and Order Management.
  • Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
  • Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating ServiceNow with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
  • Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
  • Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
  • Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science and demonstrated experience in computer operations, system analysis, programming, project implementations and technical management
  • Field service experience; including customer service management and call center support
  • Demonstrated understanding of one or more industry-standard architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman, DODAF, FEAF, Gartner/Meta, etc.)
  • Experience with key software development and integration technologies (e.g., APIs, APEX, Force.com, .Net, Java and JavaScript, XML, Web Services, HTML, SSO, data loaders, messaging, etc.)
  • Experience with RDMS concepts and structures, knowledge of SQL, structured system analysis and design methods, data migration, etc.
  • Experience with system integrations, preferably involving ServiceNow
  • Ability to migrate configurations and code between environments using industry standard tools
  • Experience with software delivery lifecycle methodologies (e.g., Agile) and project management methodologies (e.g., PMBOK) with the ability to manage multiple projects to aggressive timelines
  • Understand field service resource management, contractors, timesheets, operating hours, shifts, primary and secondary territory setup. inventory management (return, request & track)
  • Experience working independently and within a cross-functional and cross-vendor team environment; collaborating effectively, creating consensus, and driving outcomes
  • Support Bolt Data Sales activities
  • Support Bolt Data practice maturation and internal initiatives as required
  • Participate in Peer Reviews of colleague’s solution designs
  • Mentoring more junior team members in business analysis, project management, and ServiceNow best practices.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally with client and project team as needed

About Sundae

Sundae is on a mission to help homeowners achieve the best possible outcome when selling a house that needs repairs or updates.

For too long, homeowners facing difficult selling situations have had limited options and insufficient transparency. Sundae is changing that by combining technology, data, marketing, and operational expertise to connect motivated sellers with experienced local real estate entrepreneurs who can provide solutions tailored to their needs.

Today, Sundae operates a rapidly growing membership platform that equips real estate operators with the marketing, technology, systems, and support they need to acquire more opportunities, convert more sellers, and grow their businesses more efficiently.

Our team combines deep expertise across real estate, marketing, technology, and operations. Together, we're building the infrastructure that helps homeowners navigate complex situations while empowering entrepreneurs to scale responsibly and profitably.

If you're excited about building scalable growth systems, solving complex problems, and making a measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Role Overview

We're seeking a data-driven, execution-oriented Performance Marketing Manager to own and optimize Sundae's lead generation efforts across paid and offline acquisition channels.

This role is responsible for planning, executing, and improving marketing campaigns that drive qualified homeowner opportunities for Sundae members. You will manage channel performance across Google PPC, Meta, Direct Mail, TV/CTV, and emerging acquisition channels while continually testing new strategies to improve lead volume, lead quality, and cost efficiency.

Success in this role requires balancing lead quantity, lead quality, and return on investment to help members grow profitably.

As the day-to-day owner of acquisition marketing performance, you'll work closely with sales, revenue operations, creative, and external partners to ensure every marketing dollar delivers measurable business impact.

This is not an agency management or strategy role. It is a hands-on operator role. The right candidate is highly analytical, executes and optimizes independently, and builds scalable growth programs.

Key Responsibilities

Performance Marketing Strategy & Optimization

  • Own performance across paid and offline acquisition channels including Google PPC, Meta, Direct Mail, TV/CTV, and emerging channels.
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and identify opportunities to improve lead volume, lead quality, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.
  • Develop testing roadmaps for audiences, creative, offers, landing pages, bidding strategies, and channel mix.
  • Analyze performance by market, campaign, channel, and audience segment to uncover growth opportunities.
  • Recommend budget allocations based on performance trends and business objectives.

Channel Management & Execution

  • Manage day-to-day execution of acquisition campaigns across Google PPC, Meta, Direct Mail, TV/CTV, and emerging channels.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns.
  • Develop direct mail audience strategies, targeting methodologies, segmentation frameworks, and campaign plans designed to maximize response rates, lead quality, and return on investment.
  • Partner with data providers, mail vendors, and internal stakeholders to continuously test, optimize, and scale direct mail programs across member markets.
  • Partner with media vendors and platform partners to plan, launch, monitor, and optimize television and connected TV campaigns.
  • Evaluate new acquisition opportunities and conduct structured tests to determine scalability.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain performance reporting across all acquisition channels.
  • Track key metrics including CPL, CPMQL, CAC, conversion rates, and return on marketing investment.
  • Identify performance trends and provide actionable recommendations to leadership.
  • Develop forecasting models and support annual and quarterly planning initiatives.
  • Ensure accurate attribution and measurement methodologies are maintained across channels.

Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization

  • Partner with creative and web resources to improve landing page performance.
  • Develop and execute A/B testing initiatives focused on conversion rate optimization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve user experience and lead capture efficiency.
  • Monitor form completion rates, engagement metrics, and lead quality indicators.

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Manage relationships with media agencies, platform representatives, data providers, and marketing vendors.
  • Hold partners accountable to performance expectations and service levels.
  • Evaluate vendor performance and recommend process improvements, contract changes, or alternative solutions when appropriate.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of direct, hands on experience owning paid acquisition performance across both digital and traditional channels. You have personally managed budgets and been held accountable for results. This is not a coordination or support role.
  • You have run direct mail programs from the ground up: list strategy, audience segmentation, creative testing, vendor management, and response rate measurement. You understand how a mail program works mechanically, not just conceptually.
  • You are fluent in Google Ads and paid social (Meta). You can manage campaigns directly, read platform data critically, and evaluate agency performance without relying on the agency to tell you what is working.
  • TV and/or connected TV (CTV) experience is preferred. You have planned, launched, or managed television or CTV campaigns, whether executed directly or through a media agency relationship you owned.

jobs.description:
About Us

Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia’s real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

We’re a rapidly-scaling business reimagining how money moves for some of Australia’s largest merchants, organisations and payment platforms – disrupting a market that’s been overdue for change for decades. This ambition has seen us recognised as FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies Awards. Twice.

For passionate, action-oriented people, this ambition means genuine opportunity: to build category-defining infrastructure, own hard problems, and grow a career at the pace of the business around you. This isn’t incremental work – it’s the kind of experience that changes the trajectory of a career.

We believe in the power of positive human experiences, and that a deep sense of belonging creates cohesion in our culture. Even as a remote-first team, you’ll be a contributor and custodian of that culture, solving complex problems alongside talented people who are just as driven to help us deliver on our brand promise and build ‘a better way to pay’ at Zepto.

About the Role

Zepto’s engineering teams are growing! And we’re currently looking to hire a back-end and a front-end focused Software Engineer. Reporting into an Engineering Manager, these two roles will make a significant impact as we continue scaling a world-class payments platform.

Working in a scale-up means you get the opportunity to flex your skills in a variety of ways. We’re agile and always willing to roll up our sleeves to get things done. As a Software Engineer at Zepto, you can expect your day-to-day to involve:

  • Creating a world-leading payments platform, beloved by engineers, our merchants and their customers
  • Constantly improving and shipping new software
  • Collaborating and supporting your peers to create a team environment and alignment to our purpose
  • Being passionate about processes for writing, reviewing and thinking about scalable, secure, accessible and optimised code
  • Collaborating with dedicated Security, Platform and Incident Management teams to support a platform that is mission-critical to our customers, in a heavily regulated industry
  • Providing technical insight to the customer support and onboarding teams
  • Participating in our on-call rotation supporting mission-critical systems
  • Embracing the way we work with AI: play a hands-on role in integrating AI into how we work – embracing the setup, documentation, and cross-team alignment of AI tools so our processes are scalable, structured, efficient and built to last beyond any one person.

About You

You will have proven experience contributing to solving technical problems and flexing your solutions-focused mindset, to enable teams to do their best work. You have confidence in shipping code changes, and experience working alongside other engineers to find robust, scalable and maintainable solutions.

You’re energised and enthusiastic. You’re comfortable working in a busy, high-volume, competitive commercial environment, and your collaboration skills make you a valued member of the team and fundamentally a ‘Good Human’.

You are an advocate for driving AI maturity and adoption; embedding AI tools into the rhythm of daily work across the team, ensuring processes are structured, documented, and consistently followed – reducing key person dependency and building a foundation that scales.

We welcome candidates with the following experience for the Back-end Software Engineer role:

  • Solid experience in a back-end language and API development. Ruby is our core stack and therefore preferred, though not essential. Strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn matter more to us.
  • Some experience with front-end development is a bonus.
  • Experience in building solutions using cloud-based technologies.
  • Experience applying strong engineering practices such as test-driven development and continuous delivery, ideally within event-driven systems, microservice architectures and data streaming platforms.
  • Able to be effective in a collaborative team environment.
  • Someone who looks at challenging situations through a solutions-focused lens.
  • Ability to work productively in a fast-paced and agile environment.

We welcome candidates with the following experience for the Front-end Software Engineer role:

  • Solid experience in a modern front-end language and framework. React and TypeScript are part of our stack and preferred, though not essential; strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn matter more to us.
  • Familiarity with back-end-for-front-end patterns, and comfortable reasoning about where logic and state should live across that boundary.
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails and/or Golang is a bonus, with plenty of scope to grow in that direction if you want to go more full-stack.
  • Experience building responsive, accessible and performant user interfaces, ideally with an eye for UX and an ability to translate design into polished, production-ready product.
  • Experience integrating front-end applications with RESTful or event-driven APIs, and working with cloud-based technologies.
  • Experience applying strong engineering practices such as test-driven development and continuous delivery, ideally within component-driven architectures and design systems at scale.
  • Able to be effective in a collaborative team environment.
  • Comfortable presenting options and trade-offs rather than waiting for a fully specified solution, and happy taking ownership of your code from design through to production.

Why Zepto?

Headquartered in beautiful Byron Bay, Zepto has an inspiring founder story and is a customer-focused, culture-first organisation. You’ll be joining a team that champions curiosity and a pioneering perspective, and thrives in a fast-moving sector.

Just some of Zepto’s commitments to our people include:

  • Join a Talented Team: Work with world-class talent and leaders who support career growth
  • Flexible Work: A remote-first work culture, with the opportunity to work anywhere in Australia. You’ll also get access to premium co-working spaces and a Byron, Sydney & Melbourne Hub
  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
  • Wellbeing Focus: Access to Zepto’s Wellbeing Menu, which includes 3 x paid Wellbeing Days per year and access to an Employee Assistance Program
  • Annual Learning Budget: An individual learning budget, and 4 x paid Growth & Impact Days annually to focus on professional development
  • Remote-Work Support: A $500 Remote Work Budget to set up your home office upon commencement, and $300 annually from your 2nd Zeptoversary
  • ESOP: Access to Zepto’s Employee Share Program equity package

  • Розробляти та реалізовувати Go-to-Market стратегії для запуску нових функцій і сервісів.

  • Співпрацювати з PPC, CRM, Design, Product та Sales командами для реалізації маркетингових активностей.

Плюсом стане

Finalytics.ai is a leading fintech company delivering AI-powered personalization solutions purpose-built for credit unions and community financial institutions. Our platform helps member-focused organizations deepen relationships, drive growth, and deliver the right financial products to the right members at the right moment. We are a lean, mission-driven team passionate about the positive impact community financial institutions have on the people they serve.

If you're a designer who leads with curiosity, thrives in a collaborative studio environment, and wants your work to shape how millions of people experience their finances, we want to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Set the creative bar. Inspire the team and clients alike with design that's both visually exceptional and grounded in strategy, data, and user insight.
  • Collaborate across disciplines. Partner with UX designers, interaction designers, strategists, and developers to define creative direction and deliver outstanding digital experiences across web, mobile, and emerging platforms.
  • Own the craft. Translate wireframes, functional specifications, and prototypes into high-fidelity design that brings the user experience fully to life — across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Champion innovation. Continuously push the boundaries of what's aesthetically and technologically possible within our clients' industries.
  • Mentor and elevate. Invest in junior creative team members and foster a culture of cross-discipline collaboration and shared craft.
  • Deliver with consistency. Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meet deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment, and maintain an uncompromising standard of quality from concept through delivery.
  • Be a client partner. Show up with confidence and clarity in client-facing presentations, translating complex design decisions into compelling narratives.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years’ experience at a digital agency
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating quality work across digital media — including responsive web, mobile, and app design
  • Expert-level proficiency with Figma, and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Deep understanding of interaction design, branding, digital marketing, and the end-to-end creative process
  • Proven experience with mobile-first, responsive design across devices and platforms
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, iOS, data visualization — enough to design with development realities in mind
  • A natural ability to absorb feedback, self-direct, and iterate with purpose
  • Bachelor's degree in design or a related field preferred; formal design training highly valued

Bonus points for:

  • Motion design experience
  • Financial services industry background
  • Experience with data visualization and designing for complex information environments

What's in It for You

  • Work that matters — designing digital experiences used by real people managing their real financial lives
  • A collaborative, idea-driven environment where great thinking gets implemented, not shelved
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Fully remote flexibility
  • The chance to shape creative standards at a firm that's genuinely pushing the industry forward

jobs.excerpt: At Curai, we believe that access to high-quality healthcare is a fundamental human right, not a privilege.
jobs.description:
At Curai, we believe that access to high-quality healthcare is a fundamental human right, not a privilege. Our mission is to radically transform healthcare by harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and clinical expertise to make care more affordable, accessible, and effective for everyone.

About the 1099 Physician Role

    We're hiring for a 1099 Contracted Physician to join Curai Health's growing clinical care team. In this fully remote role, you'll deliver high-quality, patient-centered, virtual-first primary care to patients across the United States through video visits, live chats and secure messaging — all supported by Curai's advanced AI-powered clinical technology and proprietary electronic medical records (EMR) system. If you're a physician who's passionate about expanding access to care and excited about practicing at the intersection of medicine and technology, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

    As a 1099 contract physician, your clinical responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
  • Conducting comprehensive virtual assessments, diagnoses, and evidence-based treatment for patients across various ages and backgrounds through text-based, and video visits
  • Managing and coordinating care for chronic conditions
  • Providing preventive care, wellness counseling, and health education to promote holistic well-being
  • Ordering and interpreting diagnostic tests and lab results
  • Prescribing medications in accordance with state and federal regulations
  • Handling referrals and prior authorizations
  • Accurately and thoroughly documenting tasks and communications in the electronic medical record (EMR)
  • Completing compliance tasks in a timely manner
  • Maintaining compliance with HIPAA and confidentiality standards
  • Producing clear and efficient encounter visit notes that showcase strong medical decision-making, comprehensive differential diagnoses, and relevant, well-structured care plans

What You'l Bring

  • A Board-certified physician (MD or DO) degree from an accredited medical school
  • Board certification in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine required
  • At least 5 years of primary care experience, including adults and pediatrics
  • Active, unrestricted physician licenses in a minimum of 15 states, including:
  • At least 2 of the following: California, Texas, or Florida
  • Preference given to candidates with active licenses in: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Mississippi, New Hampshire, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, or Washington
  • At least 1 year of remote work experience preferred
  • Excellent communication, clinical judgment, and patient engagement skills
  • A self-motivated and independent work style, with a strong capacity for teamwork and collaboration
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage your time effectively in a remote work environment
  • Adaptability to evolving technology, including AI-driven tools and digital platforms

What We Offer

    Rate: $110-135/hr

    The rates listed for this position reflects what Curai Health reasonably and in good faith expects to pay at the time of posting. Actual base rate will depend on a variety of factors, including your qualifications (such as licenses), and shift/schedule.

    Culture: A mission-driven team of talented colleagues who are committed to living our values, collaborating closely, and driving meaningful impact in healthcare.

Curai Health is an equal opportunity employer and is deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. In keeping with our beliefs and values, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital or domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. To promote an equitable and bias-free workplace, we set competitive compensation packages for each position and do not negotiate on our offers. We are looking for mission-driven teammates who embody our core values and appreciate our transparent approach.

Beware of job scam fraudsters! Our company uses @curai.com email addresses exclusively. We do not conduct interviews via text or instant message and we do not ask candidates to download software, to purchase equipment through us, or to provide sensitive personally identifiable information such as bank account or social security numbers. jobs.description:
About Voltus

Voltus represents the "potential of us" to better manage energy through simple, cost and risk-free demand response programs. Our commercial and industrial customers generate cash by allowing us to maximize the value of their operational flexibility in energy markets. We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good and who have a genuine passion for delivering a cleaner energy future and for working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

The Role

The Voltus Customer Success Associate ensures customers enter the market efficiently and ready to perform successfully to earn money. You will be a critical team member throughout the customer’s journey at Voltus, managing new and existing customer onboarding from start to finish and providing ongoing account support. You will be the primary point of contact for our customers throughout their onboarding journey and will partner with our Sales,Operations, and Energy Markets teams to deliver the best possible experience to our customers. You will drive adoption and expectations at the beginning stage of the customer journey. You will schedule and lead business meetings with our internal teams and customers and effectively communicate the onboarding status to avoid any delays and ensure seamless internal handoff to drive efficient onboarding. You will continue to support our customers and sales teams beyond onboarding with account related questions and provide the best customer experience.

As a Customer Success Associate you will have four primary objectives:

  • Reduce the time it takes a customer to enter the market and ensure they are prepared to perform and earn money
  • Eliminate internal seams so other Voltans can work efficiently
  • Maintain and grow customer relationships beyond onboarding
  • Provide Sales team with ongoing account support
    • The role is a great opportunity for someone who is a problem solver and gets excited about tackling challenges that directly impact customers and Voltus’s bottom line. If you are maniacally self-initiated, process oriented, organized, awesome at growing customer relationships, focused on delivering an excellent customer experience, intelligent and a team player who finds satisfaction in getting things done, you are a great fit!

Key Requirements

  • You are process-minded and love developing new, more efficient ways to do things
  • You have attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, bias toward action, and appreciation for urgency
  • You are organized and can collect and maintain comprehensive and accurate records
  • You love customers and want to work with them daily
  • You have great “bedside manner,” with a healthy blend of persistence, diplomacy, and energy to get everyone moving in the right direction
  • You find fulfillment in helping others succeed
  • You have strong empathy for customers AND passion for revenue and growth
  • You have excellent communication and presentation skills
  • You have the ability to shift priorities quickly when necessary
  • You are great at cross-functional collaboration
  • You have strong Salesforce experience and love using technology to drive efficiency, scalability, and value for everyone
  • You understand or are interested in the role of demand-side resources in energy markets
  • You want to work with the best team in the energy industry
  • You have 3+ years experience in customer-facing role(s). Experience working with operations leaders at commercial, industrial, and institutional facilities a plus
  • You have a relevant Bachelor’s degree (preferred)
  • You are excited to work remotely
  • Experience in the energy industry and/or working with our customer profile is required
Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).
Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.
At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Kundennahes Auftreten und Erfahrung in direkter Kundenkommunikation
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Lösungen einfach, klar und überzeugend zu erklären
  • Hands-on-Mindset bei Testing, Setup und Troubleshooting
  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise

Must-have

  • Erfahrung mit Industrial Automation oder Robotics
  • Customer-facing Experience in technischer Beratung, Presales, Application Engineering oder ähnlichen Rollen

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit AMR oder Warehouse Robotics
  • Kenntnisse in PLC, IoT oder System Integration

Erfolg nach 6 Monaten

  • 5 bis 10 qualifizierte Kunden-Opportunities aufgebaut
  • 2 bis 3 erfolgreiche Piloten oder Proofs of Concept begleitetErste abgeschlossene Deals mit wiederholbaren Use Cases erreicht

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Spannende Aufgabe in einem dynamischen und internationalen Umfeld
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung eines wachsenden Geschäftsbereichs mit hoher Sichtbarkeit
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und eine teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur
  • Moderne Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf Digitalisierung, Effizienz und pragmatische Lösungen
  • Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • 2 years’ HEDIS abstraction/over-reading experience
  • Data entry proficiency
  • Working knowledge PDF, Word and Excel
  • Excellent written and communication skills

jobs.title: 3D and AI Art Director
jobs.excerpt: 3D and AI Art Director - DotYeti We're seeking a 3D and AI Art Director to lead our creative vision and drive the visual identity of our projects.
jobs.description:
3D and AI Art Director - DotYeti

We're seeking a 3D and AI Art Director to lead our creative vision and drive the visual identity of our projects. In this role, you will focus heavily on digital-first experiences and champion emerging disciplines such as 3D, AI integration, CGI, motion, and interactive activations.

You'll work closely with our design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver compelling, impactful designs that push creative boundaries and elevate the brand experience.

What you'll do:

  • Creative Innovation & Direction: Define and drive the visual identity of projects with a heavy emphasis on digital-first experiences. You'll push creative boundaries, ensuring our work is not just current, but ahead of the curve.
  • Cutting-Edge Concept Development: Oversee the ideation and execution of complex campaigns integrating 3D elements, CGI, motion graphics, and interactive digital activations.
  • AI & Tech Integration: Actively explore and integrate emerging creative technologies and AI tools into the design workflow to optimize output and spark new forms of creativity.
  • Team Leadership & Upskilling: Mentor, inspire, and challenge a team of multi-disciplinary designers. You will foster a culture of rapid experimentation, continuous learning, and technical curiosity.
  • Client & Stakeholder Evangelism: Confidently pitch and present bold, innovative creative concepts to clients and internal stakeholders, articulating the strategic "why" behind experimental or high-tech visual directions.
  • Quality & Innovation Control: Review and refine deliverables, ensuring they not only hit brand objectives but also set new benchmarks for aesthetic and technical excellence.
  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate closely with sales, marketing, and development teams to bridge the gap between creative imagination and technical execution.

Our ideal candidate:

  • Proven Leadership: Has extensive experience in a senior creative or leadership role within a fast-paced digital agency, creative tech studio, or high-growth startup.
  • A Future-Forward Portfolio: Showcases a stunning body of work that highlights mastery in digital product experiences, motion design, 3D assets, and cutting-edge marketing campaigns.
  • Tech-Fluent Toolkit: Proficient in standard design suites (Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud) plus exposure to or proficiency in 3D/motion software (e.g., Cinema 4D, Blender, After Effects) and generative AI creative tools.
  • Boundary Pusher: Possesses an experimental mindset, a keen eye for micro-interactions, and a passion for immersive digital storytelling.
  • Natural Leader & Communicator: Exceptional English communication skills (written and spoken) with the ability to articulate complex technical/creative visions simply.


Bonus Points for:

  • Deep experience working within startups, creative production houses, or tech-forward agencies.
  • A proven track record of successfully executing interactive web experiences or experiential digital campaigns.
  • Experience scaling design solutions for a diverse portfolio, ranging from agile startups to massive global enterprises.

What We Offer:

  • Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment in an independent contractor setup.
  • Paid Time Off & Benefits: Generous paid time off and mental health leave.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary with yearly performance-based raises.
  • Equipment Allowance: Allowance provided to equip your home office.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunity to grow with a talented and collaborative team.


Hiring Process:

  • Initial Interview
  • Assessment
  • Final Interview
  • Job Offer!

Note: We are currently not accepting meeting requests for this position through our website. Submit your application via this job ad.

jobs.title: JR. IT HELPDESK
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a Junior helpdesk engineer.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Junior helpdesk engineer. The person applying for this role should be a team player but also be able to work on their own initiative. Our working hours are 8:30am UK to 5:30pm UK with an hour lunch break; our client's environment and up-time being of critical importance. The technologies we use and support are varied, and thus we are looking for a person that can absorb information and learn new things quickly.

The successful candidate will have knowledge and skills in some of the following areas:

Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Windows 10 & 11 administration and troubleshooting
  • Microsoft 365 (Office, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive) support and administration
  • Active Directory user management (password resets, account creation, permissions, group membership)
  • Basic Microsoft Exchange and Microsoft 365 administration
  • Windows Server fundamentals
  • Azure Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID basics
  • Desktop application support including Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat
  • Malware, antivirus and endpoint security troubleshooting
  • Remote support using remote access software
  • Basic TCP/IP networking, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi troubleshooting and printer support
  • Apple macOS and iPhone/iPad user support
  • Hardware diagnostics, upgrades and peripheral installation
  • Customer service and ticket management
  • Documentation and knowledge base creation

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line technical support to users via phone, email and remote support tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve Windows desktop, Microsoft Office and application-related issues.
  • Support Microsoft 365 users with Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and password-related issues.
  • Create, modify and disable user accounts within Active Directory while maintaining security best practices.
  • Assist with Microsoft Exchange and Microsoft 365 administration tasks including mailbox configuration and permissions.
  • Install, configure and maintain Windows desktops, laptops and peripheral devices.
  • Investigate antivirus alerts and malware-related issues using endpoint protection software.
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting including Wi-Fi connectivity, DNS, IP configuration and printer networking.
  • Support Apple devices including macOS, iPhone and iPad connectivity and email configuration.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to second-line engineers while documenting troubleshooting steps and resolutions.
  • Maintain accurate support records and communicate progress clearly to end users.
  • Work independently to prioritise workload while collaborating with senior engineers to meet service targets.

Professional Profile

A motivated and customer-focused IT professional with experience providing first-line technical support across Windows environments and Microsoft 365. Confident troubleshooting desktop, networking and user account issues while delivering excellent customer service. A quick learner with a strong interest in Microsoft technologies, cybersecurity and cloud services, able to work independently in a fully remote environment while collaborating effectively with technical teams.

Currently we do not have a PSA / RMM solution. We have a custom AI helpdesk and use GoTo Technologies for remote access.

Working conditions:

  • Fully remote supporting UK clients
  • Mon - Fri
  • UK hours

jobs.title: Senior Modular Estimator (Structural Steel)
jobs.excerpt: Senior Modular Estimator (Structural Steel)About the RoleWe are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Modular Estimator to join our growing team.
jobs.description:
Senior Modular Estimator (Structural Steel)

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Modular Estimator to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone with strong structural steel estimating fundamentals who enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with drafting, production, and project teams.

The role is approximately 60% estimating and 40% coordination/project support, including exposure to drafting and project coordination. While experience in modular construction is advantageous, we are happy to train candidates with solid structural steel estimating experience.

Key Responsibilities

Estimating (60%)

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, BOQs, and quantity take-offs from structural, fabrication, architectural, and engineering drawings.
  • Review project documentation and identify scope gaps, risks, and cost considerations.
  • Interpret shop drawings and fabrication details to develop commercially competitive estimates.
  • Prepare and manage tender submissions within required timelines.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Maintain accurate pricing records and estimating documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and pricing accuracy.

Coordination & Project Support (40%)

  • Coordinate with drafting, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure smooth project handovers.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders regarding project scope, timelines, and technical requirements.
  • Assist in reviewing drawings and project documentation to ensure constructability and commercial accuracy.
  • Proactively raise questions, clarify project requirements, and identify potential issues before pricing.
  • Support project delivery by coordinating changes, variations, and documentation throughout the estimating process.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of estimating experience within structural steel, fabrication, construction, or related industries.
  • Strong experience preparing quantity take-offs and BOQs.
  • Ability to interpret structural, fabrication, and engineering drawings.
  • Experience using AutoCAD and/or Bluebeam.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Able to manage multiple estimates simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Nice to Have

  • Drafting experience.
  • Experience supporting modular or prefabricated construction projects.
  • Exposure to CostX or similar estimating software.
  • Experience working on international or global construction projects (Australian experience is advantageous but not required).

What Makes You Successful

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Proactive and naturally curious.
  • Comfortable asking questions and challenging unclear project information.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Detail-oriented with strong commercial awareness.
  • Collaborative and enjoys working across multiple teams.
  • Eager to learn new systems and processes.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote work setup
  • Company-issued laptop and phone
  • HMO from Day 1
  • Christmas Shutdown Leave (SIL)
  • Opportunity to work with an established Australian engineering company
  • Training and development in modular construction and company-specific estimating processes

Working Hours

  • Monday–Thursday: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM (AU Time)
  • Friday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM (AU Time)
  • 38 hours per week

Somos uma empresa brasileira com mais de 33 anos de história, conectando negócios, serviços e soluções tecnológicas que transformam organizações e impulsionam a inovação. Atuamos com ambientes On-Premises, Cloud Computing e plataformas como Microsoft Azure, AWS, OCI, GCP e Microsoft 365.

Com presença em diversas regiões do Brasil e colaboradores espalhados por todo o país, promovemos uma cultura colaborativa, sustentável e humana.

Na Teltec, valorizamos trajetórias únicas e reconhecemos que diferentes vivências enriquecem nossa forma de pensar e agir. Trabalhamos para garantir acessibilidade, respeito e equidade em todos os nossos processos, desde a seleção até o dia a dia de trabalho.

Nosso compromisso é criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam exercer seu potencial com autonomia, segurança e pertencimento.

  • Tecnologia e Inovação
  • Marketing e Comunicação
  • Gente e Cultura
  • Finanças e Administrativo
  • Operações e Logística
  • E muito mais!

📌 Importante saber

A descrição das atividades e dos requisitos variam em cada oportunidade, mas em todas será necessário anexar o laudo médico mais recente. A exclusividade deste banco não altera a forma como ocorre o nosso processo seletivo e nem os critérios avaliados nas candidaturas.

A inscrição neste banco de talentos não garante contratação imediata, mas nos permite conhecer seu perfil e considerar você em futuras oportunidades que estejam alinhadas com suas habilidades, interesses e necessidades.

Senior Software Engineer (Node.js)

Important: This role is open only to candidates currently living in Mexico or Latin America. Applications from other regions will not be considered.

Join MagmaLabs, a leading provider of expert software engineers dedicated to helping companies achieve their goals across diverse and impactful industries. We are actively seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer (Node.js) to join our fully remote team.

In this pivotal role, you will apply your passion for building scalable, high-performance backend systems to solve complex challenges for our clients in healthtech, e-commerce, fintech, and other fast-growing sectors. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining modern backend architectures powered by Node.js and cloud-native technologies, directly contributing to our clients’ success while driving technical excellence across projects.

About the Role

Are you a seasoned Backend Engineer passionate about building reliable, secure, and scalable systems with Node.js?

As a Senior Software Engineer (Node.js), you will take ownership of architectural decisions, lead backend initiatives, and ensure best practices across high-traffic APIs, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems. You’ll balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability, performance optimization, security, and observability.

Your contributions will directly impact system reliability, developer productivity, and business scalability.

If you thrive on solving complex backend challenges using modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural design, development, and continuous evolution of scalable backend applications using Node.js (preferably with TypeScript).
  • Design and implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs with clear versioning, validation, documentation, and error-handling standards.
  • Optimize database performance (primarily PostgreSQL), including schema design, indexing strategies, query tuning, and transaction management.
  • Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs, and event-driven workflows using modern queue or messaging systems.
  • Design resilient integrations with third-party APIs and services (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, monitoring).
  • Ensure code quality and reliability through automated testing (unit, integration, and contract tests).
  • Participate in code reviews, maintain high engineering standards, and actively mentor team members.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Contribute to infrastructure and deployment processes (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Improve production reliability through monitoring, logging, tracing, and performance optimization.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, including architecture decisions and operational guidelines.
  • Take ownership of complex technical initiatives and drive them to completion independently.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 7 years of software development experience, with at least 5 years focused on backend development using Node.js in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript (or modern JavaScript with willingness to work in TypeScript).
  • Experience with backend frameworks such as NestJS, Express, or Fastify.
  • Solid expertise with relational databases (preferably PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization.
  • Experience with caching and/or asynchronous processing systems (e.g., Redis, message brokers, queues).
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Jest or similar) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of secure backend practices (authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets management, rate limiting).
  • Experience working with containerization and cloud environments.
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in a remote-first environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative and lead technical decisions independently.
  • Experience working within Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience designing microservices or refactoring monolithic systems.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or advanced API contract design.
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and container orchestration.
  • Knowledge of distributed tracing and observability practices.
  • Exposure to frontend frameworks such as React.js.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical publications.

About Us

We are a team of innovative software professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality solutions across diverse industries. With a proven track record of success, we prioritize technical excellence, collaboration, and the continuous growth of our team members.

We are committed to mentorship, skill expansion, and long-term career progression within a supportive, remote-first environment.

Join us to work on impactful projects and advance your career as a Senior Node.js Engineer.

jobs.excerpt: About airSlateairSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions.
jobs.description:
About airSlate

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Romania, Ukraine, and Philippines.
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

About the team:

    AI Labs is airSlate's bet on what comes after the toolbox era of software. No backlog rituals, no six-month roadmaps, no committees — small teams, weekly ship cycles, real users from day one. We build AI-native products for the businesses that actually run the economy: the contractor booking your kitchen remodel, the dentist scheduling your cleaning, the 10-person shop drowning in W-9s and PDFs nobody designed for them. They've been stuck with decades-old software. We're here to change that, fast.

The opportunity:

    For thirty years, software gave people toolboxes — edit this, sign that, file the other thing, one click at a time. AI lets us skip the toolbox entirely and hand people the outcome: taxes filed, contracts signed, staff onboarded, done. That's not an incremental upgrade. It's a chance to make our own products — and everyone else's — obsolete, fast. Whoever builds this first wins a category. We want it to be us, and we want it to be you.

The role:

    You'll own an AI-native product end to end — not manage a backlog, not shepherd someone else's roadmap. You work closely with AI Labs' product leader, who sets the broad direction, but everything from "who is this customer, really" to "why is this metric moving" to "ship it tonight" is yours. You'll have a small team of engineers who are good, fast, and looking to you to make the next six months feel like an adventure instead of a slog.

What you'll do:

    • Get obsessed with the customer. Talk to SMB owners, watch them work, mine the signal sitting in our millions of existing users — find the problem they actually have, not the one that's convenient for us.

    • Run on hypotheses, not opinions. Form a sharp bet, design the test, read the result honestly even when it stings, move.

    • Own the funnel and the money. Activation, conversion, retention, monetization — know the numbers cold and push them yourself.

    • Turn mess into a thing worth building. Insight is cheap; a sharp, buildable product decision is not.

    • Build alongside your engineers, not above them. Prototype with AI tools — v0, Cursor, Lovable, whatever's fastest — and fix your own interface instead of filing a ticket for it.

    • Ship in days, not quarters. Idea to something real in front of a user in about a week. Then do it again.

    • Bring the energy that makes people want to build with you. This is the job where "it's just a job" gets you replaced.

Who you are:

    • ~3–5 years building software products and shipping V1s that real customers actually used — SMB experience is a strong plus.

    • Customer-obsessed by instinct, not by training — you start from their problem, not our roadmap.

    • AI-native. You use these tools every day, not just on slide decks, and you have sharp instincts for what they can and can't do yet.

    • You've run experiments that mattered — you can name the bet, the test, and what you learned when you were wrong.

    • Curious and genuinely unafraid to be wrong in public. Fast learners who chase the question outrun people who protect their ego.

    • A real nose for product — you can tell good from bad in five minutes, not five meetings.

    • Hands-on by default. Given the choice between a rough prototype and a strategy doc, you build the prototype.

    • Fluent in growth and monetization — funnels, conversion, pricing, the levers that actually move a business, not just a metric.

    • Hungry for freedom on new things — and ready to run with it the moment you get it.

Fair warning on how we hire:

    Before we talk about strategy, we're going to ask you to build something — a real prototype, a few hours of work, not a two-week slog. If that sounds like an annoying hoop, this probably isn't your role. If it sounds like the most fun part of the interview, you're exactly who we're looking for.

Why this and not somewhere else:

    Startup speed and ownership, backed by a company with 100M+ users, real infrastructure, and the resources to actually support what you build — plus direct access to leadership, because this hire is that important to us. You won't wait for permission. You'll build the thing, watch someone use it, and know within a week if you're onto something real.

What we offer

Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

Job Title: Licensed Insurance Agent

Location: Remote

Because our technology builds quotes from a customer's existing insurance information, you’ll spend more time engaging clients and closing sales and less time on data entry and quoting.   • Active and maintained P&C license (Property & Casualty) in current state of residence required.

  • Strong communication and persuasion skills.
  • Comfortable using multiple systems simultaneously, including CRM, quoting, and rating tools.
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, fully remote environment, managing a full pipeline effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with digital-first insurance platforms or insurtech environments is a big plus.
  • Familiarity with comparative raters and CRM tools (e.g., EZLynx, AgencyZoom, Salesforce)
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Dynamic, fast-paced environment with opportunities for professional growth
  • Access to industry-leading tools and resources that support your success
  • Competitive base salary + uncapped bonus opportunity
  • Incredible benefits - the best in the industry BY FAR:
    • Health, dental, vision paid at 89% (individual or family)
    • 401(k) with substantial matching
    • Generous PTO
    • Remote work flexibility
    • Career growth in a fast-scaling insuretech
    • Multi-state licensing

Schedule:

  • Full-time
  • Rotating shifts, including some evenings and weekends

Who You Are:

You’re a licensed insurance professional who enjoys helping customers find the right coverage with clarity and confidence. Tech-savvy and adaptable, you’re comfortable using modern sales tools and thrive in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment. You bring strong communication skills, a self-motivated attitude, and a genuine commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience.

jobs.description:
Transition to a Career in Cybersecurity at a Dynamic Cybersecurity Company

The cybersecurity industry is poised to grow by double digits again this year. Join the growing team at InfoDefense to provide exceptional services to our customers. Gain private-sector experience and expand your skill set with the latest in security methods and technology!

This is a remote position, but candidates must live in or near Dallas, TX, or Anchorage, AK, or be willing to relocate if offered a permanent position.

InfoDefense is an Authorized SkillBridge Organization. This position is open to personnel transitioning out of the military. The objective is to facilitate a smooth transition to a civilian career in Cybersecurity. The Cybersecurity Compliance Internship Program was designed to provide exposure to private sector business as well as a flexible schedule to accommodate out-processing. Theinternship will last for a minimum of 90 days. All candidates are required to pass a background check prior to beginning work and must be approved for the program by a commanding officer.

Job Description

We are looking for a motivated self-starter that is passionate about cybersecurity and has a strong desire to be an integral part of a dynamic team. The Cybersecurity Compliance Internship Program is designed to offer interns business and technical exposure to core elements of the cybersecurity discipline, including:

  • Audit servers, firewalls, and Microsoft 365 configuration
  • Develop monthly CMMC compliance report
  • Lead CMMC compliance, risk & security assessments
  • Manage development and sustainment of customer’s artifacts collection (evidentiary)
  • Manage development and sustainment of customer’s POA&M and SSP
  • Manage development and sustainment of organizational GRC (including policies, standards, procedures)
  • Manage development and sustainment of organizational security awareness programs (CUI Training, Insider Threat, Annual Awareness, Privileged User)
  • Manage the organization’s GRC toolkit
  • Manage the organization’s Incident Response Program

Each intern is expected to participate in industry-related activities and customer meetings as well as author three 1,000-word articles/blogs on cybersecurity-related topics.

Qualifications

Desire and ability to learn quickly, a great attitude, and good work ethic. To be considered for this internship, the candidate must be currently serving in the United States military, be eligible for the SkillBridge program, seeking an associate, bachelor, or master's degree in cybersecurity, computer engineering, or a related discipline, and have had exposure to core information security functions, including network and application vulnerability testing, role-based access control (RBAC), security information and event management, and/or computer incident management. To be successful, a candidate should be proficient in Linux and Windows, and have at least two years of information technology experience and exposure to three or more of the following security technologies:

  • Certified in Sec+, CCP, CCA or equivalent
  • Experience with NIST SP 800-171, SP 800-53, CSF, or RMF
  • Experience with Azure, GCC, GCC-High
  • Knowledgeable in firewalls, malware protection, and IPS
  • Knowledgeable in network vulnerability testing
  • Knowledgeable with encryption technologies (e.g., IPSec, SSL)
  • Knowledgeable with home office environments and Internet connectivity to enable remote work from home

Cybersecurity interns are provided with a laptop computer, docking station, monitors, keyboard and mouse, camera, and headset for remote working. Most hands-on instruction and on-the-job training are delivered using Microsoft Teams, although the opportunity for interacting on-site may also be provided. Interns must have a home office environment and sufficient Internet connectivity to enable remote work.

Interns can successfully perform the skills described in the training with minimal assistance. Evaluations are provided as either "Satisfactory" or "Unsatisfactory".

About InfoDefense

A turn-key cybersecurity solutions provider, InfoDefense provides best-in-class information protection, network security, system security, and identity and access management, as well as IT governance, and risk and compliance solutions. With a current focus on Department of Defense contractors with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) compliance requirements, InfoDefense has also served financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and government customers since 2001.

Headquartered in the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area, InfoDefense is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: SkillBridge
