jobs.excerpt: Business Development LeadTH Experiential is looking for a driven, relationship-savvy new business leader to join us as our Business Development Representative.
jobs.description:
Business Development Lead

TH Experiential is looking for a driven, relationship-savvy new business leader to join us as our Business Development Representative. You should love the hunt and have a robust skillset for identifying the right brands, opening doors, and turning conversations into revenue. This role is a rare opportunity to help shape the growth of an established agency in the $128B experiential marketing industry, where your hustle and ability to open doors that lead to new revenue, will directly fuel the next chapter of our business. If you thrive on building pipeline from scratch, owning your number, and partnering with a team that delivers world-class work, we want to talk to you.

Overview

TH Experiential is an established agency with 20 years of experience designing and producing experiential marketing programs for major brands such as Unilever, Sephora, McDonald’s, L’Oréal, eBay, DoorDash, IKEA, and Nike. As we expand, we need a dedicated “hunter” focused exclusively on new business generation. This person should be someone who can build a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities, accelerate deal velocity, and partner with leadership and creative on winning pursuits. This role reports directly to executive leadership and works closely with the Chief Creative Officer, Marketing/Growth, and Operations.

Responsibilities

New Business Development

  • Own the full top-of-funnel new business motion: prospecting, outbound, qualification, discovery, and opportunity creation.
  • Build and maintain a target account list of major brands and agencies aligned with TH Experiential’s creative strengths and ideal client profile.
  • Generate qualified meetings through outbound campaigns, networking, referrals, industry events, and account-based marketing.
  • Carry an annual revenue/bookings number and consistently deliver against pipeline and win-rate targets.

Pipeline & Pursuit Management

  • Own the full sales cycle from first contact through signed contract, partnering with the creative and production teams on proposals and pitches.
  • Lead pursuit strategy on key opportunities: discovery, scoping, pricing strategy, proposal narrative, and close plan.
  • Maintain accurate, real-time pipeline data in HubSpot and Podio; provide reliable forecasts and weekly pipeline updates to leadership.
  • Partner with Marketing/Growth on campaigns, segmented outreach, and content that supports active pursuits.

Strategic Account Targeting

  • Analyze market trends, brand spend signals, and competitive activity to identify high-value opportunities.
  • Develop point-of-view materials and tailored outreach that demonstrate understanding of each brand’s business and category.
  • Cultivate relationships with senior decision-makers at major brands as well as creative and PR agencies.
  • Represent TH Experiential at industry events, conferences, and category gatherings to build presence and pipeline.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with TH’s creative and production teams to translate client needs into compelling, scoped proposals.
  • Collaborate with the VP of Operations and Head of Production on deal structure, margin targets, and feasibility.
  • Hand off won business cleanly to the Client Lead and project teams with documented context, scope, and success criteria.
  • Contribute to the company’s sales playbook, win/loss analysis, and continuous improvement of the new business motion.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of business development or sales experience, with at least 3 years selling experiential, brand experience, event marketing, integrated marketing, or related agency services.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting or exceeding revenue targets in a quota-carrying role.
  • Existing network of brand-side marketing decision-makers and/or agency relationships.
  • Strong commercial instincts: ability to qualify hard, scope smartly, and walk away from poor-fit deals.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; confident leading C-suite conversations and pitch presentations.
  • Proficient with HubSpot; comfortable with disciplined pipeline hygiene and reporting.
  • Self-directed, organized, and energized by building from scratch in a growing organization.

Compensation, Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive base salary plus commission/bonus tied to bookings.
  • Comprehensive medical and dental coverage.
  • 401K with guaranteed contribution.
  • Generous time off (holidays, vacation, sick days, etc.).
  • Annual performance bonus.
  • Remote work.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

TH Experiential is looking for a visionary Creative Director to lead concept development and creative execution across our full portfolio of experiential work, from large-scale activations and immersive environments to hybrid and digital campaigns.

This is a leadership role for a strategic, culture-savvy, and collaborative thinker who thrives on turning bold ideas into unforgettable experiences. You will work directly with clients and internal teams to shape breakthrough work that delivers impact, drives engagement, and positions TH as a creative powerhouse in the industry.

About TH Experiential

TH Experiential is a creatively-led experiential agency built on craft, collaboration, and trusted client partnership. Since 2006, we’ve helped leading global brands create culturally resonant, meticulously produced experiences that blend storytelling, design, and real-world impact. We deliver work that shapes culture and creates moments to remember.

As experiential demand accelerates, TH is entering its next chapter of intentional growth. We’re evolving our leadership team and go-to-market approach to support a growing slate of integrated programs while protecting margins, clarity, and long-term client relationships. This role is a rare opportunity for a seasoned experiential business development leader to help define how TH grows—strategically and sustainably.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Leadership

  • Lead the ideation, development, and execution of integrated experiential campaigns that push creative boundaries and meet client objectives.
  • Champion and evolve the creative vision for projects, ensuring alignment with brand goals, cultural relevance, and innovative execution.
  • Guide cross-functional teams of 2D designers, 3D spacial designers, motion graphic designers, and strategists through the creative process with clarity, inspiration, and decisiveness.

Client Engagement & Strategy

  • Serve as a senior creative partner and trusted advisor to clients, offering strategic insight and inspiring confidence through every phase of a project.
  • Collaborate closely with strategy, business development, and production leads to ensure creative excellence and strategic alignment.
  • Confidently present concepts and campaign thinking to senior client stakeholders and executive teams.

Team Building & Mentorship

  • Manage, mentor, and inspire a team of creatives, providing actionable feedback, fostering growth, and building a collaborative culture of excellence.
  • Attract top creative talent and nurture an environment that values originality, inclusivity, and accountability.
  • Partner with agency leadership to shape the future of the creative department and elevate TH’s creative profile.

Executional Standards

  • Oversee the development of all creative outputs including presentations, visual design, copy, environmental design, and video/motion content.
  • Ensure all creative deliverables are cohesive, brand-aligned, and executed to the highest standard.
  • Maintain ownership of the creative vision throughout production, actively collaborating with internal and external partners to ensure flawless execution.

Agency Marketing

  • For every project, partner with cross functional leads on a content capture plan for marketing materials.
  • Once projects are completed, lead the creative team to develop recaps, case studies, and sales/marketing collateral.
  • Partner with the marketing team to support website updates, social posts, and award submissions.

Core Competencies

Creative Excellence

  • Strong concept development skills, with a portfolio of impactful experiential campaigns, branded environments, and cross-channel content.
  • Ability to translate strategic insights into bold creative direction across in-person, digital, and hybrid formats.
  • Deep understanding of brand storytelling, cultural trends, and audience behavior.

Leadership & Vision

  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to inspire teams and clients alike.
  • A strong point of view coupled with an openness to collaboration and iteration.
  • Ability to lead high-profile campaigns under pressure while nurturing a culture of creativity and care.

Operational & Financial Acumen

  • Experienced in scoping creative projects, managing timelines, and working within budget parameters.
  • Ability to align creative ambition with business objectives, ensuring profitability and scalability.
  • Skilled at balancing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

Experience & Requirements

  • 10+ years of creative experience with a proven track record in experiential marketing, brand activations, and cross-platform campaigns.
  • 4+ years in a senior creative leadership role with client-facing experience and team oversight.
  • Strong command of visual design, storytelling, and presentation tools (Google, Adobe CC, Figma).
  • Familiarity with digital engagement tools and platforms (e.g., AR/VR, interactive content, social media integrations).
  • Experience working with multi-agency teams and managing external creative/production vendors.

What Defines Your Style

  • You inspire through action and lead with integrity.
  • You say "yes" to new ideas and bring others along with you.
  • You love solving problems creatively and strategically.
  • You’re energized by building culture and growing talent.
  • You deliver under pressure without compromising the work, or your team.

How You Elevate Our Culture

  • You foster a creative culture rooted in respect, generosity, and a shared pursuit of excellence.
  • You’re not only creative—you’re responsible, practical, and clear.
  • You show up for your team and your clients with curiosity, humility, and passion.

Role Overview

Join TH Experiential as a Senior 3D Experiential Designer, a pivotal role in shaping the future of physical brand experiences. Reporting directly to the CCO and partnering with the Creative Strategy and Senior Art Director, you will define the creative vision for high-value RFP responses and upfront pitches, leading the entire design-to-production process.

You will architect transformative, immersive brand environments, specializing in large-scale exhibitions, innovative retail pop-ups, and cutting-edge experiential marketing activations. This role requires you to invent, design, and hyper-render distinctive physical spaces from concept creation through to final production.

As the leader in spatial realization, you will translate ambitious creative concepts into buildable realities. This includes developing detailed 3D models, high fidelity renderings, and fabrication ready architectural plans. This critical function requires a balance of inspired spatial aesthetics, technical feasibility, and disciplined budget management.

About TH Experiential

TH Experiential is a creatively-led experiential agency built on craft, collaboration, and trusted client partnership. Since 2006, we’ve helped leading global brands create culturally resonant, meticulously produced experiences that blend storytelling, design, and real-world impact. We deliver work that shapes culture and creates moments to remember.

As experiential demand accelerates, TH is entering its next chapter of intentional growth. We’re evolving our leadership team and go-to-market approach to support a growing slate of integrated programs while protecting margins, clarity, and long-term client relationships. This role is a rare opportunity for a seasoned experiential business development leader to help define how TH grows—strategically and sustainably.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on RFP Development by crafting compelling spatial proposal responses, ensuring alignment with client goals and brand voice
  • Translate creative briefs into actionable, fabrication-ready spatial designs, including floorplans and elevations
  • Develop design concepts and related visuals through concept sketching and floor plan development, elevation drawings, 3D modeling, renderings, etc
  • Create detailed 3D models and high-quality renderings using SketchUp, Rhino, or Cinema 4D
  • 3D experience design including attendee journeys and value engineering all activation touchpoints
  • Create consumer flow charts highlighting event and guest flow throughout developed spaces
  • Manage fabrication and print vendor relations, handling troubleshooting and negotiations as needed
  • Review all material sample finishes and QC creative execution
  • Create decor + graphics packages for live programs, including sourcing event elements and mapping out suggested signage placement/materials/sizing
  • Collaborate with production teams, creative directors, and fabricators to ensure design feasibility and budget adherence
  • Conduct site visits and oversee installations to ensure design accuracy and highest creative execution
  • Post-events, participate in key learnings and their integration into future projects

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2–6+ years of experience in experiential marketing, set design, or environmental design.
  • Proficiency in 3D modeling software (e.g., SketchUp, Rhino, 3ds Max).
  • Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Understanding of building materials, lighting, and fabrication techniques.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing immersive environments, experiential activations, or similar projects.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines.
  • Experience with rendering engines (e.g., V-Ray, Lumion, Twinmotion).
  • Knowledge of AI design tools (e.g., Midjourney and Flora)
  • Familiarity with motion graphics or animation
  • Experience working with multi-agency teams and managing external creative/production vendors.

Four Kitchens is looking for a Backend Engineer with experience in PHP and Javascript who is proficient in or wants to learn Drupal development. Backend Drupal Engineers with Four Kitchens are growing their skills, and passionate about learning best practices. They work collaboratively within close-knit project teams to develop new custom and community modules, troubleshoot and maintain existing code, and to migrate content from legacy CMS systems.

As a Web Chef, you will first and foremost exemplify our Core Values. You will also exhibit a natural curiosity and a passion for making cool stuff for the web. We expect our whole team to self-lead and prioritize as distributed team members—your frequent communication and participation in company culture will be key indicators of your engagement at Four Kitchens. Being a constant self-educator is essential, so advanced degrees are not a requirement for this role as we believe experience and passion are more important.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace and building a diverse team. At our core, we believe deeply in diversity and inclusiveness as being critical parts of a healthy team. We aim to create an environment where everyone, from any background, can do their best work. If you look at our team page and don’t see yourself, don’t shy away. Come work with us!

As a Backend Drupal Engineer, you will...

  • Write clean, scalable code that adheres to project requirements and client needs
  • Develop for multiple devices and interactions
  • Participate in peer code reviews
  • Help architect Drupal solutions for our clients
  • Write PHP and Javascript code to build custom modules and migrations
  • Work closely with Clients on project engagements to deliver exceptional code, consulting and advice
  • Proactively identify, own and solve hard technical challenges
  • Passionately keep pace with rapid innovation in web technologies
  • Engage with the open source community via code contributions, projects, presentations, blog posts, etc.

You’re our next Backend Drupal Engineer if...

  • You have mid-level experience and a passion for developing with PHP and Javascript
  • Exposure to the Drupal or a similar CMS like Wordpress. If you are passionate about web development and interested in learning the specifics of working with Drupal or Wordpress we will get you up to speed
  • You have a foundation in computer science fundamentals, and an understanding of how web technologies work
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills for presentations, demos, client consultations and ongoing documentation
  • You have industry experience in higher education, media or publishing
  • You have worked with React or other modern Javascript frameworks
  • You come from an agency environment or from a small to medium-size business

About Four Kitchens

Four Kitchens is a leading digital strategy firm with strong roots in the open-source and free-culture communities. We build websites and apps to engage audiences on virtually any device in our pursuit of setting knowledge free. We hire developers, designers, and strategists with strong consultative skills and a desire to make a difference, both to our clients and each other.

Our Values and Culture

Our Web Chefs bring more than their professional skills to the kitchen, and we encourage everyone to help guide our company’s direction. We all have a strong voice in what we do and how we do it. Collectively, our values—The Way Of the Web Chef—guide how we interact with each other, our colleagues, and our clients. Four Kitchens is not just a company—it's a closely-knit team. We believe in the power of individuals coming together to do something bigger than they could have done alone.

Distributed Work

We believe the right talent is where you find it, and, as a distributed team, we’re excited to be pioneers in what we believe is the future of work culture. Even though we have no physical office, we strive to remain a collaborative community using tools like Slack and Zoom. The Web Chefs span four time zones, yet our goal is for team members to feel like they are working together in the same room, even if they're thousands of miles apart.

Our Benefits

We care for our teammates as people, which is why we have a generous PTO policy, encourage time off, and have an excellent benefits package. Not only do we strive to maintain a healthy work-life balance, but we also participate in exciting and creative projects outside of client work to expand our abilities.

We hope you'll join us!

How to Apply

Include the following materials with your application:

  • Cover letter.
  • Tell us about which of our Core Values resonates with you the most and why!
  • Resume/CV.
  • Samples of your recent coding work. Public contributions on Github or are a bonus, but any recent work is helpful. We are looking for a code sample that will be a good starting point for a conversation about your experience and development philosophy. If the example you provide is part of a team effort, please describe your contribution. Feel free to redact or obfuscate any client-identifying info. If you cannot show us actual code, please be prepared to explain your coding philosophy and standards in detail.

Four Kitchens welcomes applications from all backgrounds, particularly from people of color; women; LGBTQ+ people; immigrants or refugees; differently-abled people; and people from low- or moderate-income backgrounds.   • 3+ years of full-cycle SaaS sales with consistent quota attainment as an individual contributor.

POS-9034

About the Team

Revenue Hub is building the backbone for businesses to sell, bill, get paid, and manage revenue inside HubSpot. Our systems handle billions of dollars in transactions, so correctness, clarity, and predictability matter.

We're building a commerce platform where the data model, APIs, and flows are first-class. Reps, admins, and agents all work from the same foundation. The vision is a single, connected revenue flow: Contact to Deal to Quote to Order to Contract to Invoice to Payment to Reconciliation. When that flow is clean and trusted, revenue context becomes available across the whole business: marketing can attribute spend to real revenue, sales can forecast on actual billing behavior, and service teams can see renewal risk before it's too late.

About the Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help shape the technical future of Revenue Hub. This is a very hands-on role. You'll write code, dive into services, review tough designs, debug messy systems, and directly own the architecture behind CPQ, Billing, Payments, and Revenue OS. A big part of this role is defining how external developers and AI agents interact with those surfaces safely and predictably.

What You'll Do

Build a simple, consistent, extensible platform

  • Shape the technical roadmap across CPQ, Billing, and Payments with strong, opinionated patterns.
  • Define and evolve core domain models so pricing, products, contracts, invoices, and payments behave predictably in the UI, over the API, and inside agent-driven workflows.
  • Design the API and platform contracts that let developers, partners, and AI agents extend Revenue Hub without coupling to internals.
  • Create frameworks that make the platform easy to extend without adding complexity.

Be a deeply hands-on, high-leverage builder

  • Write code regularly. Lead design reviews and build high-impact systems end-to-end.
  • Own large multi-team initiatives that span CPQ, Billing, and Payments.
  • Take prototypes to production at scale.

Lead architectural direction

  • Set patterns for extensibility, contract boundaries, financial correctness, event-driven consistency, and how AI agents safely interact with commerce objects.
  • Push for simplicity where the domain wants to get complicated, and consistency where surfaces can drift.

Partner deeply with product leadership

  • Influence product strategy across CPQ, Buyer Portal, and Revenue OS.
  • Help teams make clear tradeoffs between speed, correctness, compliance, and long-term platform health.

Raise the bar across the org

  • Mentor senior engineers and tech leads.
  • Drive thoughtful design decisions and guide learnings from incidents and large migrations.
  • Help teams align on patterns that reduce complexity and increase reliability.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems with strict correctness requirements.
  • Strong instincts for API and platform design. You've built things external teams depend on and know what that responsibility feels like.
  • Background working with complex state machines, financial flows, or high-integrity data models.
  • Familiarity with agentic systems and what it means for AI to safely act on structured data, not just read it.

jobs.excerpt: ROLE OVERVIEWSunCentral is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager, Market Operations, to drive the community solar Subscription to Cash (STC) revenue cycle for select community solar markets within our RevOps department.
jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

SunCentral is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager, Market Operations, to drive the community solar Subscription to Cash (STC) revenue cycle for select community solar markets within our RevOps department. This role requires a solid understanding of community solar best practices, a proven ability to deliver high-quality business results, exceptional attention to detail, and strong communication skills. The ideal candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive approach to learning, ensuring continuous improvement in driving revenue growth, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

As Manager, Market Operations, you will play a crucial role in optimizing subscription origination, subscription management, utility partnerships, customer experience and SunCentral platform development, while also identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, streamline processes and ensure high-quality outcomes. You’ll work closely with multifunctional project teams to manage and drive community solar subscription revenue for Pivot Energy and our clients. In this capacity, you'll be responsible for adhering to standard operating procedures, managing people and client relationships, reporting business results, escalating issues, proposing solutions and supporting other projects as assigned by your manager.

This position requires an individual who is business focused, customer-centric, process-oriented, data-driven, and capable of balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and manage an assigned team of community solar associates for select community solar markets and clients.
  • Develop go-to-market strategies to originate and manage high-quality community solar subscriptions at scale.
  • Define community solar subscription offerings for assigned markets including eligibility, underwriting and commercial terms.
  • Oversee subscription management, project and utility data and risk management practices to optimize revenue, minimize attrition, ensure program compliance and adhere to related financing covenants.
  • Collaborate effectively across Pivot to drive revenue and optimize our community solar subscription to cash revenue cycle.
  • Manage third-party client relationships and related community solar subscription service agreements including commercial terms, statements of work, pricing and invoicing.
  • Educate internal and external stakeholders on community solar subscription market dynamics, program opportunities, operational planning considerations and risks.
  • Cultivate a high-performing, collaborative and results-driven team culture.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

  • 2+ years of leadership experience in the community solar industry.
  • Proven business management, people management, organizational development, and communications skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes, troubleshoot, implement solutions and deliver high-quality business results.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with an aptitude for building trust and rapport.
  • Naturally curious, self-directed, and able to work autonomously to consistently meet deadlines.
  • Highly proficient with MSOffice, SalesForce, AI and data analytics tools.
  • Aligned with Pivot’s values: kindness, empathy, integrity, professionalism, balance, impact, and determination.
  • Bachelor's degree; Master’s degree, preferred.
Recruitment Agency Notice:
We appreciate your interest in partnering with us; however, we are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role.

ABOUT PIVOT

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and
families.
We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. Our portfolio includes projects that reduce energy burden for income-limited families, create workforce pathways for under-represented groups within the solar industry, and include robust community investment opportunities.
As a Certified B Corporation and one of Denver’s “Best Places to Work”, we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. We evaluate every internal decision on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors to determine if our actions will result in a net positive impact on the community, our employees, customers, shareholders, and the environment. Learn more in our annual ESG Report.
At Pivot, our core values guide our work internally and externally:
·Impact – We hold ourselves accountable to having a measurable impact on our people, communities, and the planet
·Balance – Put family first; work hard/have fun
·Determination – Find ways to be successful no matter how difficult the challenge
·Professionalism – Impress everyone we touch, be a team player
·Honesty – Be truthful and transparent, externally and internally
·Kindness – Create an environment where kindness, empathy, and vulnerability are embraced

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION and JUSTICE STATEMENT

At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. We seek to build a team that invests in relationship building, celebrates each other’s successes, and makes space for the unique contributions and working styles people bring into Pivot.
Pivot invests in company-wide trainings, assessments, and programs to advance internal inclusion and equity practices, such as employee allyship building, cross-cultural communications, and equitable hiring and management protocols to increasingly recognize bias and ensure mutual respect and belonging.

EEO STATEMENT

Pivot Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to increasing the diversity of its workforce. We actively work to cultivate an inclusive culture that welcomes, empowers, and enables equitable career growth for employees regardless of background.

jobs.description:
Director of Payer Access

The salary range for this position is between $200K and $245K
Actual salary at the time of hire may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant qualifications, skills, and experience. The company also currently offers a Long-Term Incentive Plan (cash plan) of 25% base salary, annual performance bonus target of 25% base salary (subject to meeting plan requirements).

Position Overview

The Director, Payer Access is a field-based strategic role responsible for shaping and executing payer access initiatives across national and regional health plans, PBMs, and GPOs. This role focuses on improving clinical utilization management policies, securing favorable formulary access, and driving business strategies that expand patient access for key brands. The Director collaborates closely with cross-functional partners—including Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, and Market Access leadership—to ensure alignment and effective execution of payer strategies. This position reports to the National Director, Payer Access.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead formulary negotiations and secure positive coverage, reimbursement, and access across assigned payer accounts.
  • Influence and shape clinical policy and utilization management criteria in collaboration with key payer decision-makers.
  • Develop comprehensive business plans for priority accounts, identifying opportunities to enhance formulary status and pull-through.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior leaders at national and regional payers, PBMs, and GPOs.
  • Prepare and lead timely, accurate, and compelling RFP responses representing the payer value proposition for the product portfolio.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure aligned messaging and integrated execution of market access strategies.
  • Analyze contract performance and leverage insights to optimize negotiation strategies and business outcomes.
  • Present payer value propositions and health economics information to support access discussions.
  • Represent the organization at major industry and payer conferences (e.g., AMCP, PCMA, Asembia).
  • Ensure all activities are executed in full compliance with laws, regulations, and company policies

Strategic Impact & Key Interfaces

The Director, Payer Access directly impacts reimbursement, patient access, and overall brand performance by securing and maintaining favorable payer coverage. The role acts as a key external ambassador to payer organizations and a critical internal partner who aligns payer insights with brand and organizational strategy. Primary interfaces include Market Access Leadership, Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Patient Services.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred (MBA, MPH, or related field).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
  • Minimum 5 years of direct market access experience engaging national and regional payers.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating formulary access, UM criteria, contract terms, and payer RFPs.
  • Proven experience shaping clinical policy and driving access outcomes within payer accounts.
  • Strong analytical capability with experience evaluating contract performance and business impact.
  • Established relationships with key payer decision-makers.
  • Solid proficiency with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
  • Proven track record in business planning and leading strategies that expand market share and improve access.

Core Competencies & Behaviors

  • Strategic account leadership and influence
  • Skilled negotiator with strong analytical decision-making
  • Executive level communication and presentation skills
  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management
  • High integrity, ethical judgment, and compliance mindset
  • Ability to operate autonomously and manage multiple priorities
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
  • Adaptability in a dynamic payer and healthcare environment

Key Success Factors

  • Strengthened payer relationships built on credibility and value
  • Improved formulary access and clinical policy outcomes
  • Effective alignment between payer account strategy and brand priorities
  • High-quality RFP responses and strong contract performance
  • Clear communication of payer insights to internal teams
  • Consistent compliance with all regulatory and company standards

Ethics & Compliance

  • Demonstrates the highest level of ethics, integrity, and professionalism.
  • Ensures all payer interactions and negotiations adhere to legal, regulatory, and company policies.
  • Maintains accountability for compliant behavior and promotes a culture of transparency and trust.

*If you are a California resident applying for the above position, please review ourCalifornia Applicant Privacy Notice.

Job Specification: Sales Representative (Commission-Only)

Focus: Microsoft Licensing & New Business Acquisition

Experience: Not Required — (strong network & passion for sales essential)

About the Role

We are looking for a driven and well-connected Sales Representative to join our team on a commission-only basis. This role is perfect for someone who has a strong personal or professional network and a genuine passion for sales. No formal experience is required — just the ability to build relationships, identify opportunities, and close deals.

Your main responsibility will be to sign up new business for Microsoft licensing solutions, including Microsoft 365, Office licenses, and related cloud services.

  • Ability to work independently and manage your own time.

  • Full training and support on Microsoft licensing.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who is hungry to earn, loves talking to people, and isn’t afraid to reach out to their network. You should be someone who thrives on opportunity and enjoys the challenge of closing new business.

Job Title: Web Server Administrator

Job Overview: As a Web Server Administrator, you will be responsible for the management, configuration, and maintenance of web servers to ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability. You will collaborate with other IT professionals to deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot web server environments, ensuring seamless operation of websites and web applications.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Server Configuration and Deployment:
    • Configure and deploy web servers, including Apache, Nginx, or Microsoft IIS, according to project requirements.
    • Install and configure server software, applications, and security settings.
    • Implement load balancing and scalability solutions to handle varying levels of web traffic.
  2. Performance Optimization:
    • Monitor server performance and optimize configurations for speed, efficiency, and resource utilization.
    • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, including CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network issues.
    • Implement caching mechanisms and content delivery networks (CDNs) to improve website performance.
  3. Security Management:
    • Implement and maintain security measures to protect web servers from cyber threats, including malware, DDoS attacks, and unauthorized access.
    • Configure firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and SSL/TLS certificates.
    • Conduct regular security audits and apply patches and updates to mitigate vulnerabilities.
  4. Backup and Disaster Recovery:
    • Develop and maintain backup and disaster recovery plans for web server environments.
    • Perform regular backups of web data and configurations and test restoration procedures to ensure data integrity and availability.
  5. Monitoring and Troubleshooting:
    • Monitor server logs, performance metrics, and system alerts to identify and troubleshoot issues proactively.
    • Investigate and resolve server-related incidents and service disruptions in a timely manner.
    • Collaborate with development teams to diagnose and resolve web application issues impacting server performance.
  6. Documentation and Reporting:
    • Maintain detailed documentation of server configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.
    • Generate reports on server performance, uptime, and security incidents for management and stakeholders.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Proven experience as a web server administrator or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in configuring and managing web servers, such as Apache, Nginx, or Microsoft IIS.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, protocols, and standards (HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, TCP/IP).
  • Experience with server-side scripting languages (e.g., PHP, Python, Perl) and database systems (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
  • Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security measures for web servers.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA Server+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  • Knowledge of web application firewall (WAF) solutions and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS).
  • Experience with automated configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
  • Understanding of DevOps principles and practices.

Note: This job description serves as a general guideline for the responsibilities and qualifications of a Web Server Administrator. Specific requirements may vary depending on the organization's needs and the complexity of its web infrastructure.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Customer Success team ensures our customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. As Senior Manager on the US Scale Customer Success team, you will lead a team responsible for a high-volume portfolio of mid-market customers in the private sector.

This is not a traditional CS leadership role. It is a builder role with an explicit mandate to transform how Samsara engages customers at scale. You will own segmentation strategy, coverage design, and digital, automated, lifecycle & AI-driven engagement programs supported by targeted high-impact human interactions — while holding accountability for renewal outcomes.

You will set the standard for what great Scale CS looks like, and personally step in when customers or situations demand it. The expectation is not just to run the team well — it is to make it fundamentally better.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada or the US, excluding the SF Bay Metro, NYC Metro, and Washington DC Metro.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Segmentation strategy: determine customer segmentation into service tiers and engagement models that blend targeted human interactions and scalable programs for a high-volume portfolio of mid-market accounts in the US private sector
  • Renewal outcomes: drive retention as the primary lens for every operating decision, not a reporting exercise
  • Expansion collaboration: partner with Sales to drive growth within accounts
  • Product adoption: work with CSMs to drive breadth and depth of product adoption
  • People leadership: hire, develop, and manage a team of CSMs, each managing portfolios of 100+ accounts
  • Productivity and efficiency: drive measurable output per CSM through AI, automation, digital programs, lifecycle workflows, and smart tooling integrations
  • AI-forward: champion experimentation and adoption of AI-powered workflows and tools to enhance customer engagement and team productivity
  • Risk management: identify and mitigate risk at scale using data-driven insights
  • Cross-functional leadership: partner with Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Business Technology to increase team productivity and improve customer experience
  • Escalation leadership: step into critical customer situations personally and providing leadership coverage when it matters, balancing strategic oversight with hands-on resolution

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management
  • 4+ years of direct people management experience leading CSMs or similar customer-facing roles with a portfolio of 100+ accounts each
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly redesigning a scale, tech-touch, or digital CS model with measurable retention or expansion outcomes
  • Demonstrated ownership or significant influence over retention and expansion outcomes
  • Strong analytical capability; comfortable using data to drive prioritization, segmentation, and performance management.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, organizational change, and fast growth in a high-volume environment
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year accredited institution

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience at a SaaS company with a hardware or IoT component
  • Experience integrating AI into CS workflows to drive measurable team productivity
  • Advanced proficiency with Gainsight (or similar customer success platforms)
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales on expansion and account strategy

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$142,800—$229,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Samsara is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the In-Vehicle Experience (IVX) team whose target is to turn our in cab camera from a surveillance tool into an intelligent, trusted in-cab companion. The IVX platform controls the voice, content, and communications delivered to drivers through Samsara’s AI-powered dash cameras, and this role is at the center of defining how that experience evolves.

In this role, you’ll own the platform that powers in-cab experience and build features that help drivers feel trusted, informed, and connected while on the road. You’ll work across firmware and full-stack engineering, and partner with PM teams across the organization to design reusable frameworks and deliver customer-facing features. This work sits at the intersection of AI, hardware, and human-centered design, requiring a rare blend of technical depth, customer empathy, and platform thinking.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

  • You want to solve problems in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment: You thrive where problems are complex, new solutions are constantly being introduced, and you push yourself to try new things — including shipping AI-powered products that don’t yet have a playbook.
  • You care about the people who power the physical economy: You believe frontline workers deserve technology that recognizes their contributions, communicates with them on their terms, and genuinely improves their day — not just monitors them.
  • You appreciate candid feedback and an experimental mindset: Samsara employees challenge the status quo and recognize failure as part of the learning process. We encourage each other to be honest and hold ourselves to high standards.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Samsara’s In-Vehicle Experience platform — the system that governs all voice, content, and communication delivered to drivers through the dash camera.
  • Define and prioritize a portfolio of features that allow our clients to interact with the in-cab camera as a trusted companion to their daily workflow
  • Build the in-vehicle experience platform and prioritization layer for internal teams
  • Partner with firmware and full-stack engineering teams to navigate hardware and embedded system constraints and deliver polished, reliable in-cab experiences.
  • Champion the driver’s perspective through continuous customer research — conducting ride-alongs, interviews, and usability sessions to deeply understand how non-desk workers interact with in-cab technology.
  • Collaborate with AI and ML teams to integrate intelligent features into the in-cab experience
  • Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and drive a continuous cycle of experimentation and iteration grounded in data and customer feedback.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-powered or ML-driven features
  • Strong customer research skills with experience translating insights into successful product strategies.
  • Platform thinking experience — a track record of designing systems and frameworks that serve multiple downstream consumers
  • Excellent communication skills; able to align cross-functional stakeholders and translate complex technical tradeoffs for diverse audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MBA Preferred.

  • Experience building in-vehicle products.
  • Experience with voice-based or audio products, or designing for hands-free and eyes-free interaction patterns.

jobs.excerpt: About PavilionPavilion began as a bold experiment to solve a personal problem.
jobs.description:
About Pavilion

Pavilion began as a bold experiment to solve a personal problem. In the early 2010s, founder Sam Jacobs realized that the higher he climbed in go-to-market leadership, the lonelier the journey became. Those peer conversations – equal parts therapy, strategy, and camaraderie – sparked a global community of GTM professionals united by shared learning and support.

Today, Pavilion serves nearly 10,000 members worldwide with industry-leading retention and profitability. At over $10M ARR, the brand is synonymous with excellence in GTM leadership.

The Opportunity

We're seeking a Vice President of Marketing to lead Pavilion's next era of growth—defining how we attract, engage, and retain members across their full journey.

This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategist with expertise in today’s growth marketing tactics, who blends creativity with discipline and understands that long-term growth depends on both attraction and retention. Demand generation expertise is central to this role: you should be someone who has personally built and run acquisition programs, not just directed them through partners. You should also be fluent in building AI-driven tools and workflows — able to speak concretely about agents or automations you've built and the measurable impact they had on a marketing team's output.

Core Responsibilities

Growth Oversight (≈30%)

  • Bring demand generation expertise directly to the table: paid, SEO, and event acquisition programs, whether run in-house or supported by agencies.
  • Manage external agencies running paid, SEO, and event campaigns, with the credibility to evaluate and challenge their strategy rather than simply relay it.
  • Maintain ROI discipline and brand alignment across acquisition programs.
  • Test and evaluate new channels to reach GTM professionals globally.

AI-Driven Enablement

  • Build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows that support marketing functions — for example, content production, segmentation, campaign reporting, and/or lead scoring.
  • Bring specific, namable examples of AI tools or agents you've built in past roles, along with the business impact they had (time saved, output increased, cost reduced, etc.).
  • Stay ahead of emerging AI technologies and embed them into team workflows.

Member Lifecycle Marketing

  • Create programs that drive activation, engagement, and renewal.
  • Partner with Sales & Success on onboarding, nurture, and milestone communications.
  • Develop referral and win-back campaigns that turn satisfied members into advocates.

Brand & Communications

  • Lead Pavilion's brand presence across web, social, events, and content.
  • Oversee thought leadership, PR, and storytelling that elevate Pavilion's reputation and member value.
  • Collaborate with Education and Community teams to highlight member success and insights.

Strategy & Leadership

  • Build an integrated marketing plan that balances brand storytelling, lifecycle engagement, and scalable growth.
  • Translate Pavilion's mission into clear messaging across every touchpoint—from awareness through renewal.
  • Partner with leadership to evolve brand architecture and positioning.
  • Define and measure success across acquisition, retention, and member satisfaction.
  • Lead a small, high-performing team (3–4 people).
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and creative excellence.
  • Establish key marketing KPIs, dashboards, and optimization frameworks.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years in marketing, including 3–5 in leadership within membership, community, or subscription models.
  • Demonstrated demand generation expertise — direct, hands-on experience building and running paid, SEO, or other acquisition programs, not solely managing agencies.
  • Proven success in integrated brand and lifecycle marketing.
  • Experience managing agencies or contractors for acquisition programs.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents or AI-driven workflows for marketing use cases, with the ability to name specific tools or systems built and describe their measurable impact.
  • Strong content and communications background; comfort with analytics and budgets.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • Preferred: Experience in B2B SaaS or professional development; understanding of retention tactics, event marketing, and community storytelling.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • Audit demand generation and lifecycle performance.
  • Identify quick wins for engagement and retention.
  • Recommend and begin building AI tools/agents and process improvements.
  • Build alignment with leadership and member-facing teams.

  • Marketing positioned as a driver of both growth and member satisfaction.

  • Stock options in a profitable, mission-driven company

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue
  • All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Senior Security Architect needs 7+ years experience

Senior Security Architect requires:

Must have app/sec or DevSecOps experience, and a track record of supporting software development teams.

VPN, Security System Planning

Senior Security Architect duties:

Secures enterprise information by determining security requirements; planning, implementing, and testing security systems; preparing security standards, policies, and procedures.

Plans security systems by evaluating network and security technologies; developing requirements for local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), virtual private networks (VPNs), routers, firewalls, and related security and network devices; designs public key infrastructures (PKIs), including use of certification authorities (CAs) and digital signatures as well as hardware and software; adhering to industry standards on-prem, remote (DR), and cloud environments.

Enhances security team accomplishments and competence by planning delivery of solutions; answering technical and procedural questions; teaching improved processes; mentoring team members.

jobs.excerpt: About PavilionPavilion began as a bold experiment to solve a personal problem.
jobs.description:
About Pavilion

Pavilion began as a bold experiment to solve a personal problem. In the early 2010s, founder Sam Jacobs realized that the higher he climbed in go-to-market leadership, the lonelier the journey became. Those peer conversations – equal parts therapy, strategy, and camaraderie – sparked a global community of GTM professionals united by shared learning and support.

Today, Pavilion serves nearly 10,000 members worldwide with industry-leading retention and profitability. At over $10M ARR, the brand is synonymous with excellence in GTM leadership.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Systems Engineer to own the connective tissue across our core business systems, data warehouse, and customer access logic.

You will be responsible for how data moves between systems controlling critical processes like sales, payments, product operations, and reporting. You will build and maintain the integrations, pipelines, models, and entitlement logic that ensure our teams can trust customer, subscription, payment, engagement, and revenue data.

This is a hybrid engineering role: part data platform, part backend systems, part business systems architecture. The right person can write strong Python and SQL, work comfortably with APIs and webhooks, understand how SaaS systems fit together, and make practical and sustainable architecture decisions independently.

Responsibilities

  • Validate and implement the next chapter of Pavilion’s system architecture
  • Own integrations across core systems, including systems like Stripe, HubSpot, Hivebrite, Slack, Snowflake, AWS RDS or similar, and other third-party tools.
  • Design and maintain reliable data flows between operational, product, sales, and financial systems, including entitlement logic and payments workflows.
  • Build and maintain pipelines, transformations, and data models for customer, subscription, payment, revenue, engagement, and access data.
  • Own the technical layer for entitlements and customer access logic.
  • Support system migrations and new tool implementations, including data mapping, QA, and downstream reporting impacts.
  • Improve data quality, freshness, observability, testing, and monitoring.
  • Document architecture, source-of-truth decisions, data definitions, and system workflows.
  • Partner with Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions and write requirements independently.
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly and balance speed with long-term maintainability.

What Success Looks Like

  • Our system architecture is fit-for-purpose, streamlined, observable, and reliable.
  • The data warehouse becomes a trusted foundation for reporting, operations, and decision-making.
  • Customer, payment, entitlement, engagement, and revenue data are interconnected and reconcilable.
  • New systems, migrations, and integrations are implemented cleanly.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, backend engineering, or business systems engineering.
  • Strong Python experience for building integrations, pipelines, APIs, automations, or backend services.
  • Advanced SQL and experience with modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake)
  • Prior ownership of operational databases such as AWS RDS, Postgres, or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party SaaS tools (e.g., Slack, Hivebrite, Circle, Notion, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, event-driven workflows, and data synchronization.
  • Experience with payment, subscription, and CRMs is required; Stripe experience or ability to demonstrate deep understanding of Stripe documentation is necessary.
  • Familiarity with Hubspot API and prior exposure to subscription businesses is highly preferred
  • Demonstrated skills creating entitlement systems, access-control logic, or subscription-based products is ideal; ability to incorporate automated workflows into the logic will also be critical.
  • Strong documentation habits and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to make sound, scalable architecture decisions in a fast-moving environment.

Why Join Pavilion

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization that prioritizes the professional growth and success of its members above all.
  • Work directly with some of the brightest GTM operators and executives in the industry.
  • Be part of a collaborative team that prides itself on putting kindness first.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote role, with a distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and outcomes over face time.
Salary: $185,000

Why You’ll Love it Here

jobs.excerpt: We are growing the team behind our Autonomous Database Operations service.
jobs.description:
We are growing the team behind our Autonomous Database Operations service. This is a role for a strong database engineer who wants to work in a fundamentally different way. You will not be manually tuning queries or working through a ticket queue. Instead, your expertise directly shapes the autonomous systems that do that work — across MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB environments running on AWS and Azure.
You will govern how the system resolves incidents, own the quality of its decisions, act as the expert escalation point for complex episodes that fall outside autonomous resolution, and work directly with customers on strategic database operations matters. Over time, you will deepen your coverage across all supported platforms and cloud environments.
This role is offered in Poland on a B2B contract basis, with remote working.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Database expertise.
    1. Solid commercial experience across two or more of the following platforms: MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB — with a clear ambition to develop across all five.
    2. Strong experience with performance tuning, query optimisation, indexing strategies, and capacity management in production environments.
    3. Sound understanding of database security, backup and recovery architecture, and compliance requirements.
  • Cloud database experience.
    1. Hands-on experience with cloud-managed database services — such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, or Azure SQL Database — and an understanding of how operational practice differs in cloud-native environments compared to on-premises installations.
    2. Familiarity with AWS or Azure platform fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, identity and access management, and infrastructure-as-code practices as they apply to database operations.
  • Automation mindset.
    1. A demonstrated instinct for automation — you reach for a script or pipeline before a manual fix, and you have a track record of eliminating repetitive operational work rather than just supplementing it.
    2. Comfort reading and adapting existing automation, even if you have not previously designed end-to-end remediation pipelines from scratch.
  • Operational judgment.
    1. The ability to assess a complex database situation quickly, decide on the right course of action, and communicate clearly under pressure.
    2. Comfort with ambiguity and ownership in a fast-moving environment where customer estates vary and problems are not always well-defined.
Desirable Qualifications
  • Cloud database certifications — such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, AWS Certified Database – Specialty, or equivalent — or demonstrated depth in lieu of formal certification.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role within a managed service or platform company, rather than purely internal or project-based delivery.
  • Familiarity with database observability tooling, event-driven architectures, or AIOps platforms where systems take autonomous action based on observed state.
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted automation applied to IT operations, including evaluating automated decisions and improving them over time.

Job responsibilities

  • Govern and improve autonomous resolution. Review how the system has resolved database incidents and maintenance requests, identify failure patterns, and continuously improve resolution logic, tuning policies, and governance guardrails. Translate customer compliance, data governance, and availability requirements into enforceable operational policy, ensuring automated actions remain within safe, auditable, and recoverable boundaries.
  • Act as the expert escalation point. Assess complex or novel database episodes — performance crises, schema-level incidents, corruption events — that fall outside autonomous resolution, make fast and well-reasoned decisions, and feed those learnings back into the system. Know when to intervene and when to let automation proceed, and communicate that rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Work directly with customers. Build trust in autonomous resolution with customer stakeholders, advise on how to get the most from the service across their database estate, and contribute to customer success on strategic database operations matters.
  • Build and improve automated operations. Contribute to automated remediation workflows and self-healing database patterns that reduce manual intervention across customer environments.

Participate in an on-call rotation for complex episodes requiring human judgment outside standard business hours — the majority of incidents are handled autonomously, so genuine out-of-hours intervention is the exception rather than the rule.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology projects with major clients.
  • A supportive, collaborative, and innovative work environment.
  • Continuous professional development opportunities.

Job Type Full-time : Location: Fort Worth | Department: Technology | Work Location Type: #remote #hybrid

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

At the scale IREN operates, storage is a critical performance system. Every GPU in our clusters depends on data moving reliably, at speed and at volume. When storage falls short, AI training stalls, inference degrades and our customers feel it immediately.

The role of Senior Storage Engineers owns storage infrastructure end to end. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role. You will design and deploy storage systems, keep them performing under demanding AI workloads, and troubleshoot complex faults quickly and decisively when things go wrong.

The right person has spent years with their hands in large-scale storage environments.
